name: CDEX
full_name: China Dark matter EXperiment - neutrino and double-beta programme
summary: CDEX uses low-background germanium detectors at Jinping for dark-matter, neutrino and rare-decay research. Its natural-germanium CDEX-1 and CDEX-1B data have also been used to search for germanium-76 neutrinoless double-beta decay.
detection_principle: Germanium crystals serve as both isotope source and ionization calorimeter. Point-contact readout enables low thresholds, while high-energy pulse-shape selection and anticoincidence reject backgrounds in double-beta analyses.

status.label: Multiple stages
status.evidence: CDEX-1B reported a neutrinoless-decay half-life constraint from a natural-germanium dataset.

collaboration.name: CDEX Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

key_parameters.name: CDEX-1B published limit
key_parameters.value: T1/2 above 1.0 x 10^23 yr at 90% confidence

results.summary: CDEX-1B reported a neutrinoless-decay half-life constraint from a natural-germanium dataset.

science_scope: CDEX is a multipurpose dark-matter and rare-event programme. Its implemented natural-germanium searches and proposed enriched-germanium arrays have different masses, backgrounds and projected sensitivities.
